reviews.author: Miller Russell
reviews.text: Came in for alignment after I put on new shocks on my older truck myself, this shop was recommended to me by Hillsborough Tire folks. Fast and very fair pricing. Will be back, thanks very much

reviews.author: Glenn Lozuke
reviews.text: 1st time customer here. I needed a shop where I could order tires and get an alignment. These guys were very reasonable, professional and quick. I wouldn't hesitate to use them again. Top notch!

reviews.author: Paul Bullock
reviews.text: It was a pleasure collaborating with the Frazier’s Garage team. Although I had an appointment scheduled for a later date in the week, they were accommodating and accommodated my schedule by fitting me in earlier to complete the necessary repairs for my truck, including an alignment, new tire installation, and balancing.

reviews.author: Heather Smithey
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend these guys over and over again!!! Went in this morning with a very shaky car, Lee was very helpful and honest. I felt comfortable from the moment I walked in and spoke with him. Dropped my car off not long after they opened, got two new tires and a perfect alignment in a very reasonable amount of time and have recommended to several of my friends just hit his afternoon!!! I picked my car up and had a smooth ride home!! Thanks again guys for all your hard work. I will definitely be using them for all my mechanical work from this point on.

reviews.author: ricardo rodríguez laguna
reviews.text: The last time we went to this shop, we asked the owner to check a part he had put in our car just three months ago, because another test showed it might be broken. When I talked to him, he quickly said it couldn’t be the part and that other tests weren’t reliable. I trusted him and agreed to let him do his own check. I left the car with him on a Friday and asked him to leave it outside so I could get it over the weekend if I needed. But even after I sent messages and called many times, he didn’t answer me and left the car locked inside his shop all weekend. In the end, he told me the same thing without fixing the problem (the problem is the part he changed), charged me $180, and left me without a car for the weekend. He didn’t take any responsibility and only talked about the 'value of his time.' It was very disappointing for a place that seemed to have so much potential.

reviews.author: Nicholas Odorizzi
reviews.text: The most professional and honest experience. Called for a quote on a water pump replacement. They called back the same day and made an appointment immediately. After I dropped off the vehicle, they called to ask if a wanted to change the plugs while they were there. (It was in fact, the scheduled time to change them according to users manual, and thanks to them for reminding me). The key point being, they gave me the option. I had spoke to other mechanics in area who notified me " they were going to replace whatever they felt like, and charge me later, after the fact." When I picked up the vehicle they charged me the exact quote they gave without trying to upcharge me on BS. The job should have taken at least two days in my opinion but, didn't. They had it done first thing the next morning. (After giving it a good test drive I assume to check for errors). The car has been running great since. So, In short, Professional, Fast, Accurate Pricing, and Trustworthy. Frazier's is going to be my "GO TO' Garage from now on!

reviews.author: Caitlin Deanne
reviews.text: I got my very first car in September and I was looking for a home for all the time ups and this place was highly recommended. I got an oil change, rotation and balance the first time I came and it was inexpensive and the staff was absolutely wonderful. I didn’t feel uncomfortable like some places make you feel I also didn’t feel pushed into anything. They’re very straight forward with you, honest and kind, not to mention great work! I have found my cars permanent mechanic and if you’re in the market for a new one, I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Joel W
reviews.text: My Accord was towed to Frazier's because it was the nearest garage when the alternator died on our trip from MD to SC, stranding us on the side of the freeway. I could tell this was a professional shop when we got there. The young lady at the desk was very friendly and helpful. I have done a good bit of my own car repairs over the years, and I could tell they really knew what they were doing. We arrived at 4 pm (an hour before they closed), they got the part on short notice, and the mechanic/tech Matt stayed late to get it installed. Professional, honest, knowledgeable, and fair. Very thankful to have gotten to Frazier's Garage.

reviews.author: Ryan Scott
reviews.text: Background - I'm a backyard DIY mechanic who generally avoids shops. I usually only go to them for tire installs, AC trouble, and alignments. All that said, I found my go-to shop here at Frazier's garage. Why? Because I took my wheel off tonight and discovered that they put anti-seize on each lug and each lug was torqued to factory specs (I happened to use a torque wrench to break my lugs loose before jacking up the vehicle, which allowed me to discover this). I've used tons of tire shops during my life and 100% of the time they overtorque the lug nuts. Even discount tire who proudly used a torque wrench, but only after applying ~300+ ft-lb with a pneumatic impact driver. I am sensitive to stuff like that because of my background as a quality engineer at an automotive manufacturing plant. All of that to say, go here because they do the little things correctly. If they do the little things well, they can be trusted to do the bigger jobs too.

reviews.author: jay nixon
reviews.text: Called to get a price on install of aftermarket exhaust I purchased. Lady that answered didn't know much but wanted to make an appt for me a month out for install though she said they might not be able to install... So I said I'll come by in a few mins down the road and she insisted I wait a month to be told possibly then, they can't do the job. Also the price she gave was OUTRAGEOUS. $400. I installed it myself in my driveway in under an hour. Top notch shop here

reviews.author: Susan Gray
reviews.text: I have had several problems with my car over the last 3 years and have always taken it to Frazier's Garage. I can highly recommend them and their prices are very reasonable. The new manager is very knowledgeable, always correctly diagnoses the problem and gives a quote before doing any work. Should another problem arise, he always calls to see if he should go ahead with the work and lets me know what it would cost. On occasion, it has been difficult to arrange for a ride, and if necessary he has always been willing to provide a ride either to or from the garage. The young lady in the office is always courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Dan Clark
reviews.text: Have always had a good experience with Fraziers. They have worked on 8 different vehicles for me, ranging from new tires to rear axle replacement to new transmission. They've always been fair and done what they said they would. Thank you for your honest, prompt, quality service!

reviews.author: Seth Mycko
reviews.text: Fast service at a great price! They fixed my Ford Fusion's A/C, brakes, rotors, and another issue all in less than a day and never offered any service that was wasn't necessary. Great people at this garage. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: MedGar Properties
reviews.text: I was very disappointed in the last visit my car need it and oil change and a battery. They charge me over $300. When I ask for an itemized bill, they charged me $167 for the battery and almost $70 fee for “testing” the battery. I asked them why they are testing a battery that’s supposed to be brand new and it’s supposed to be working. The answer did not satisfied my curiosity. When I ask for the old battery, they told me that they were going to charge me $25 because that is a “core” charge. If I will not take the battery, they will be charging me those $70 anyway. I did not have time for arguments or for taking the car to another shop. I pay them what they asked. BUT WILL NEVER TAKE MY CAR THERE EVER AGAIN .

reviews.author: Ryan Carroll
reviews.text: The staff at Frazier's has never let me down. When I moved to the area I had the dreaded task of finding a good, reliable mechanic. Well, I found them. I never feel like the price they give me is too expensive, and they always fix the problem. Good prices, good work, good people!

reviews.author: Gene Smith
reviews.text: Being the owner of a plumbing company with several vehicles, and several personal vehicles that have needed repairs over the years, I can say without a doubt. Fraziers Garage is top notch. You can always expect to be treated with respect, and they’re always fair and honest.

reviews.author: john doss
reviews.text: Went in to get my vehicle's check engine light diagnosed and they fixed it right the first time. Had been to 3 other shops and they ended up just replacing parts the guys at Frazier's ended up finding a small vacuum leak and even cut their diagnostic charge in half all while fixing the problem! Gained my trust and a customer for life. I ended up taking advantage of their alignment for 50 bucks!

reviews.author: Jeff Dugan
reviews.text: Being in a broke down situation,far from home is never a good situation. The staff at Frazier’s stepped up big time in helping arrange a tow, provide accurate diagnostics, and a prompt repair. Professional in every regard, and fairly priced too. A solid shop!

reviews.author: Ashley Lewis
reviews.text: Whenever I need work done and I call Frazier's, they get me good prices and get me in with in a reasonable time frame. They are honest and upfront, and I have not had any issue with the work they have performed.

reviews.author: Phillip Alderson
reviews.text: Very bad experience on my last visit. Didn’t believe me when I told them the tires had not been rotated since they last did it and refused to take any responsibility for a stripped lug. Made no accomodations at all, basically called me a liar. I wasn’t about to pay them to fix their mistake so I told them just to tighten the four remaining lugs. Took it to another shop a few days later and guess what, another stripped lug on that same wheel! It’s a shame as they were my go to shop for a while and I hate leaving a negative review but I can’t abide such poor service AND being called a liar.

reviews.author: Brian Burtram
reviews.text: Took car in for inspection. Failed for marker light and signal. Was told to return for re-inspection after repair. Have been back twice and they are too busy to spare the minute that it would take to check the two lights. First return there were 3 guys standing around looking at a car on rack, yet they had no time to look at 2 lights...I do not recommend this business if you are expecting good customer service.

reviews.author: William Murphy
reviews.text: What can I say negative ? Nothing , I gave them a call and explained my van's problem and told them when I needed it back . They delivered as agreed , also gave me a ride home and as well as picked me up when repairs were complete . I am not saying they provide taxi service for repairs and I do live close to them 2 miles or so but it made it very convienant for me . I also spoke with repair tech that performed repairs while in the works , he was very informative to me and polite . New management is the guy that gave me a ride home ! Thanks for ride Craig !

reviews.author: odauverd
reviews.text: i'm not a very outgoing person but i have changed several transmissions and do everything i can myself. i changed my shocks and checked my tierods and i remember it very vividly because i was surprised how they had no play at 24 years old. i asked for an alignment and they showed my the wheel moving and i thought about it imediately but i just froze for some reason and i could see that they didnt like me. i asked them to use their impact on the top of my shocks, which could have possibly caused the wheel to move back and forth over time (just one day tho) they charged me 50$ extra for no real reason because they didnt even tighten those two bolts. then they test drove my car without asking me, floored it to at least 4000 rpm and didnt even notice my stuck parking brake (i park it in gear without the e brak and pull the brake open from under the car whenever i need it need it). i dont know what warranted all this disrespect but it made me so angry that i dont think i'll ever let a mechanic touch my car without watching again. im so angry with myself for not standing up for myself when i saw the play in my wheel that hadnt been there a day before. i dont want to post this but i cant sleep just thinking about this. meet the mechanics and see if they like you before letting them do anything. now im gonna be tired at work where i dont make $115 an hour like these people and it makes me so mad. -reply. I had drill for the army the day after that alignment but I just checked and the play y'all found and it's gone. Honestly i was being crazy. I'm sure yall didn't loosen those bolts just to charge me to fix it and I'm sorry for accusing you but driving my car like it was stolen is most definitely disrespect so I changed this to 3 stars and 15$ for two grease fittings when the cars already in the air is a tax.

reviews.author: Tonya Simmons
reviews.text: At first I wasn't very pleased because they didn't check everything out to start with like I asked I had to ask again to check things like ball joints and anything that had to do with the front end they did check it out and like 4 things wrong they wouldn't have if I wouldn't have asked them to check it out again. They fixed those problems so that was great but then I also asked for an inspection while they had it. They said they did and even charged me for it but I couldn't find the paper showi g it passed inspection so I called them before going to license plate agency and to find out if I need to get a paper before I go they told me no it should be in the system so I go wait in line at the license plate agency only to be told there is nothing showing I had an inspection so I called fra,it's back to tell them that so of course I had to drive from burlington back to mebane to get the paper only to find out they never actually did the inspection so then I had to wait for them to do the inspection and needless to say I did not make it back to burlingron in time to get my tags renewed that day. The work they did was good but $1700 later and a second trip for my inspection im just not sure if I would go back again I really wanted to like them and use them for all my repairs but I will definitely check around before I go back there.

reviews.author: Kevin Riggs
reviews.text: Recently had my vehicle worked on here at Fraisers Garage (NewTransmission) and seeing I could rate and give a post I surely wanted to do so. First off the staff here whether in the office or in the shop is very pleasant to talk and work with. That’s Especially nice to have in the situation I was in where as they do things go bad at the wrong time as right after Christmas. Having to move to the area and not having a mechanic which I grew up knowing and trust or is willing to give a hand in hard times I’m sure Lee and crew can fill that spot. I went to a shop to get an answer on my problem at hand before Fraser’s and ended up paying several hundred dollars and not a thing was fixed at all. not to mention haveing 3 mechanics tell 3 diff story’s on the phone about what they did fix figure that one out. I won’t give the name of the shop as I’m not petty to bash on FB just know if you want honesty stop on by Frasers. The job I had done would have been pricey anywhere and don’t think any could have done better price wise considering I truly believe in you get what you pay for and Lee and crew again deliver quality not just quantity but do strive to get you taken care of as soon as possible. I still have a few things to get taken care of and know I will be taken care of by Fraser’s garage before I even take it back in this week. I also honestly feel that in a time of need or that you need help that Fraser’s will or would work with you to get you going ASAP no matter what the circumstances they just seem like that good of a group. They are concerned about your family and how you will get around while there working on your vehicle and making sure your not struggling without to long. So all in in all it’s easy to see who to go to when you have car troubles. Or if you prefer you can go to the wrong place like I did 1st not knowing and paying hundreds for something you don’t need and possibly being sent back out in a dangerous vehicle. I don’t look forward to repairs but when I do need a hand I know who to call , thanks Lee and crew .(((And it’s Frazier’s Garage, came back a few days later and realized I wrote Fraser’s above))).as for an update I did take my vehicle back and it is being taken care of.

reviews.author: Natalie Pax
reviews.text: I had a quick, effective and easy service experience at Fraziers that I am satisfied with. I got a standard oil change and was pleased with the the direct and efficient friendly service that I received.

reviews.author: smallfaucet
reviews.text: I own an 1998 F 150. These guys fixed what the Ford dealership couldn't fix.....what Jay's Automotive said couldn't be fixed AND what two other shops said they did not want to work on. It was a little more than I wanted to pay but the job was completed and my truck runs again! I will continue to bring my truck to Frazier's.

reviews.author: Charles Joyner
reviews.text: Called for appointment made it for next day at 10 am. They took car at 10 it was ready in 30 minutes. With excellent paperwork showing what they did to the car for it's alignment. Will use them again.

reviews.author: Thomas Sutton
reviews.text: I live about 40 mins away close to Raleigh, yet this is my go-to repair service for years now. Best costs, personable and accommodative staff, and thumbs up on the repairs! I appreciate all you do. See you again soon! Thomas

reviews.author: Ross Barbee
reviews.text: Had to have a water pump replaced. The work was done on time and less than they estimated! Could have taken me for a ride with the higher estimate but they were honest and gave me the true price.

reviews.author: Evan C. MacGibbon
reviews.text: Under new management now. They went from good to best. Timely, dependable work that supports our local community. Always helpful and cheerful. Great place to get your car inspected, too!

reviews.author: Judith Willett
reviews.text: Great staff, good work at a fair price! My car has well over 300,000 miles on it now and I'm looking forward to 400,000! Thanks, Frazier's!

reviews.author: Scott Morse
reviews.text: I called for an appointment for my wife's car and they fit me in right away. They were quick and very pleasant to talk to. I would recommend them and will be back for future work!

reviews.author: Hayden Marino
reviews.text: The staff is super knowledgeable and shoot you straight. I have brought a few different issues to them and they have helped me with all of them. I highly recommend this garage.

reviews.author: Brandon Andrews
reviews.text: They installed a lift on my truck and did an outstanding job. No issues what so ever and price was more than reasonable!

reviews.author: Big Willy
reviews.text: BEWARE! Lived here in Mebane for over 20 years now. Frazier's is being ran by someone new. The customer service, quality workmanship, and honest upfront price quotes are now a thing of the past.

reviews.author: Misty Birmingham
reviews.text: Always great Customer service And reasonably priced Services. Plus I can usually get my car serviced within days of making Appointment.

reviews.author: Lee Wood
reviews.text: Great place to get your car or truck serviced. Best prices in town. Now selling tires making it a one stop shop for all your vehicle needs.

reviews.author: brennan washburn
reviews.text: The staff was friendly, helpful and honest. They went above and beyond in helping me get my truck ready ASAP.

reviews.author: Harry Balzac
reviews.text: Very helpful and friendly employees. I have been using Fraziers since 2005, have always received great value for my money.

reviews.author: Jon Miller
reviews.text: I took my truck there for an exhaust leveling kit and trailer hitch. They did a great job. The exhaust came out just as I asked for it.

reviews.author: Joyce Young
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Frazier the staff was very helpful. I would highly recommend them to anyone. Great prices friendly and inviting atmosphere!!

reviews.author: Michael Silverberg
reviews.text: Really helpful people when you have an urgent need. Reasonable prices and they always describe the problem and make reasonable suggestions. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: jean freeman windom
reviews.text: First time using this garage..nice website. Just wish $70 diagnostic charge had been dropped since they repaired my car

reviews.author: Cindi Stout
reviews.text: I will only bring my vehicles to Frazier's Garage. Professional front desk and outstanding mechanics.

reviews.author: Mark S.
reviews.text: Great , timely service and they leave detailed info on repair receipt. Prices seem reasonable as well.

reviews.author: Kyle Griffin
reviews.text: They are great to work with and are honest about expectations. They are very busy but are easy to work with.

reviews.author: robert pilgrim
reviews.text: Liars. Dishonesty. All while smiling and spreading thier Christian morals. Lol. Court system is the last place they need to take someone with inside info. Lol

reviews.author: Michelle Garner
reviews.text: Quick and easy. Let me know I had an oil leak without pressuring me. Last mechanic didn't have time to look at it.

reviews.author: Hunter Duff
reviews.text: Great experience with a well rounded and knowledgeable staff. I was fixed up and on the road in no time.

reviews.author: Shafi Goodwin
reviews.text: May God continue to bless Y'ALL for what you do---for your contribution to humanity. -THE Revolution of LOVE
